description: This is a Java source file defining a REST controller (HelloController) for a Spring Boot application. It includes basic endpoints for a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health status, and application info, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints for a notes backend, including welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and info endpoints.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message when the root URL is accessed.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a health check endpoint returning 'OK'.
